title: tiered-fallback-quota-trimmer-with-lease-preservation
author: Aisha Patel
ci_status: pass (integration rerun after flaky regional test)
description: Motivation: during a regional capacity spike we observed aggressive quota reclamation that immediately revoked connection leases and cancelled in-flight streaming/kv requests, causing higher error rates and tenant churn. This change implements a tiered fallback quota trimmer plus a short lease-preservation window to avoid cancelling active leases mid-stream. The new trimmer operates in three tiers: 1) soft-trim: low-impact prefix trimming limited per-epoch, 2) aggressive-trim: proportional trimming when soft measures don't relieve pressure, and 3) emergency-cap: blunt eviction only when node health suggests imminent overload. Connection leases are preserved for a configurable time window (lease_preserve_window_ms) as long as the in-flight request has an active KV or streaming token; leases can still be reclaimed after the window. The design reduces sharp spikes in erroring requests while still allowing capacity reclamation. Changes: - runtime/load_shedder/quota_trimmer.go: new tiered algorithm, metrics, and config knobs - runtime/connection/lease_manager.go: lease-preserve semantics, graceful revoke API - controller/slot_reclaim_controller.go: orchestrates coordinated trims across nodes to avoid simultaneous aggressive trims - telemetry: emits quota_trim.{tier,attempts,affected_tenants} and lease_preserve.{count,avg_duration} - docs/ops/quota-trimmer.md: operational guidance and rollback steps - unit/integration tests and a small e2e harness for regional failover scenarios Rollback plan: disable feature flag (quota_trimmer.enabled=false) on control plane and trigger a soft-recover job to force leases to be reclaimed normally. We added a runtime kill-switch to force immediate reclaim only for emergency operator actions. Also included migration notes for Dedicated customers who set custom slot lifetimes. Rationale and safety: the trimmer defaults to conservative soft-trim behavior; emergency caps require explicit operator opt-in. The lease-preservation window is small (default 5s) to balance risk. This PR is focused on reliability and minimizing customer-visible errors during overloads.

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: lease_preserve may delay reclamation and allow temporary overloads if misconfigured. Mitigation: strict upper bound on lease_preserve_window, conservative default (5s), operator kill-switch for immediate reclaim, staged rollout behind a feature flag, and extra observability to surface reclaimed vs preserved lease ratios.
release_notes: Introduce tiered fallback quota trimmer and short lease-preservation window to reduce in-flight cancellations during regional capacity pressure. Default behavior is conservative; feature behind flag. Ops: see docs/ops/quota-trimmer.md for rollout and rollback steps.
summary: Adds conservative, tiered quota trimming and lease preservation to reduce customer-visible errors during overloads while retaining operator controls for fast reclamation.
